title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: more indicator variants and larger detection groups
notes: claim 60: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents the higher limits, but does not state the automatic arrival behaviour asserted by the default-state field. The administrator paths and Microsoft 365 E5 inclusion are supported; the categorical assurance that end users see nothing is not documented.

claims.claim: Detection groups can adjust global exclusions that remove items from scoring across policies.
claims.quote: These types of exclusions apply to every trigger and indicator for all policies that you create within a tenant. By using detection groups, you can modify a built-in global exclusion to make it specific for your organization's needs.

claims.claim: The higher-limits change is on on arrival without administrator action.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants higher limits 10 500 enable automatically default. Read the roadmap, policy indicators, detection groups, settings and Get started pages; none states automatic arrival behaviour for this change.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "unknown". Add to What's changing: "Microsoft has not stated what happens on arrival if no administrator acts." The documented creation limits and absence of a separate higher-limits switch do not establish automatic rollout behaviour.

claims.claim: No separate setting to enable the higher limits is documented, including on the policy indicators and detection groups pages.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants higher limits 10 500 enable automatically default. Read policy indicators, detection groups, settings and limits; the creation procedures state the limits without a separate higher-limits switch.

claims.claim: No source says existing behaviour changes merely because these limits rise.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management indicator variants higher limits 10 500 enable automatically default; variant limits detection group 500 end user experience changes. Read roadmap, policy indicators, detection groups and settings; no automatic existing-policy change is stated.
